Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.common.market

Class MarketClock

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.common.market.MarketClock
@Component public class MarketClock extends Object
Tells every service which market session is in force, from MarketCalendar and the market.hours.* settings. common is outside each app's component scan, so an app that needs it imports it, as with JwtService.
  • market.hours.mode: REAL (the default) follows the NYSE clock; ALWAYS_OPEN is always the regular session, for e2e and CI runs at any hour.
  • market.hours.force-session: pins a session, so a demo can show any state at any hour. Ignored when always open.
  • market.hours.force-minutes: how long a forced session lasts from startup before the regular session opens, e.g. to watch queued orders fill; 0 (the default) pins it for good. Each service counts from its own startup, so they may disagree for a few seconds.
